# covr ![](reference/figures/logo.png)

**Code coverage without the unnecessary suffering.**

## Why covr2?

Because I was tired of fighting `covr`…

My code passes locally. It passes in CI/CD across different operating
systems and R versions. Everything works. Then coverage fails.

No useful message. No report. No clue. Just failure, followed by another
round of tedious debugging to figure out what the hell happened.

`covr` modifies your code’s AST to instrument it for coverage. Sometimes
that instrumentation breaks perfectly valid code, yet you’re left
debugging your code instead of the coverage tool. Even the original
maintainers acknowledge that instrumentation can change program
behaviour. That’s understandable. **What’s not understandable is
throwing away the entire report when something goes wrong.**

## The goal

`covr2` aims to make coverage reporting robust by default.

- **Fail gracefully.** When instrumentation or tests encounter errors,
  preserve whatever coverage results can still be collected and report
  what went wrong.
- **Keep what works.** Retain the familiar `covr` workflow and coverage
  reports.
- **Make CI/CD painless.** Generate coverage reports and badges, ready
  for publication to GitHub Pages.
- **Reduce configuration.** Provide the reporting dependencies,
  including `DT` and `htmltools`, out of the box. No more assembling
  three scripts and half a dozen dependencies just to publish a coverage
  report.

The philosophy is simple: coverage tools should help developers, not
create another debugging project.

If your tests pass but coverage instrumentation breaks, you should get
useful diagnostics and whatever results remain available—not an empty
directory and another afternoon wasted.

**Less debugging the coverage tool. More developing software.**

# Installation

``` r

install.packages("covr2")

# For devel version
devtools::install_github("munoztd0/covr22")
```

``` r

usethis::use_github_action("test-coverage")
```

# Usage

For local development a coverage report can be used to inspect coverage
for each line in your package. *Note* requires the
[DT](https://github.com/rstudio/DT) package to be installed.

``` r

library(covr2)

# If run with no arguments implicitly calls `package_coverage()`
report()
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`as_coverage()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/as_coverage.md)
  : Convert a counters object to a coverage object
- [`as_coverage_with_tests()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/as_coverage_with_tests.md)
  : Clean and restructure counter tests for a coverage object
- [`azure()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/azure.md) : Run
  covr on a package and output the result so it is available on Azure
  Pipelines
- [`code_coverage()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/code_coverage.md)
  : Calculate coverage of code directly
- [`codecov()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/codecov.md) :
  Run covr on a package and upload the result to codecov.io
- [`coverage_to_list()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/coverage_to_list.md)
  : Convert a coverage dataset to a list
- [`coveralls()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/coveralls.md)
  : Run covr on a package and upload the result to coveralls
- [`covr2`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/covr2-package.md)
  [`covr2-package`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/covr2-package.md)
  : covr: Test coverage for packages
- [`covr2.record_tests`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/covr2.record_tests.md)
  : Record Test Traces During Coverage Execution
- [`current_test_call_count()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/current_test_call_count.md)
  : Retrieve the number of times the test call was called
- [`environment_coverage()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/environment_coverage.md)
  : Calculate coverage of an environment
- [`exclusions`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/exclusions.md)
  : Exclusions
- [`file_coverage()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/file_coverage.md)
  : Calculate test coverage for sets of files
- [`file_report()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/file_report.md)
  : A coverage report for a specific file
- [`function_coverage()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/function_coverage.md)
  : Calculate test coverage for a specific function.
- [`gitlab()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/gitlab.md) :
  Run covr on package and create report for GitLab
- [`has_srcref()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/has_srcref.md)
  : Is the source bound to the expression
- [`in_covr()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/in_covr.md) :
  Determine if code is being run in covr
- [`is_covr_count_call()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/is_covr_count_call.md)
  : Is the expression a call to covr2:::count
- [`is_current_test_finished()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/is_current_test_finished.md)
  : Returns TRUE if we've moved on from test reflected in .current_test
- [`new_test_counter()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/new_test_counter.md)
  : Initialize a new test counter for a coverage trace
- [`package_coverage()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/package_coverage.md)
  : Calculate test coverage for a package
- [`percent_coverage()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/percent_coverage.md)
  : Provide percent coverage of package
- [`print(`*`<coverage>`*`)`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/print.coverage.md)
  : Print a coverage object
- [`report()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/report.md) :
  Display covr results using a standalone report
- [`tally_coverage()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/tally_coverage.md)
  : Tally coverage by line or expression
- [`to_cobertura()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/to_cobertura.md)
  : Create a Cobertura XML file
- [`to_sonarqube()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/to_sonarqube.md)
  : Create a SonarQube Generic XML file for test coverage according to
  https://docs.sonarqube.org/latest/analysis/generic-test/ Based on
  cobertura.R
- [`truncate_call()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/truncate_call.md)
  : Truncate call objects to limit the number of arguments
- [`value()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/value.md) :
  Retrieve the value from an object
- [`zero_coverage()`](https://munoztd0.github.io/covr2/reference/zero_coverage.md)
  : Provide locations of zero coverage
